    7|       |/**

    9|       | * @brief A class for a gunction that can be used to describe analytic time
   10|       | * domain shaped.
   11|       | *
   12|       | * This supports functions of the form x[0]*t^2 + x[1] where the values that can
   13|       | * be set are elements of the x vector, and it can be evaluated as a function of
   14|       | * time at a later date. For time evaluation, it is assumed that this function
   15|       | * should be evaluated at t=0.
   16|       | *
   17|       | * Not that this vector should always start from 0, and you should not skip any
   18|       | * indexes.
   19|       | *
   20|       | * There are builtin labels, such that the arbitrary vector indexes can be
   21|       | * turned into human readable labels.
   22|       | */
   23|       |

   25|       |namespace math {

   32|       |   * @param args The user args from the evaluate function
   33|       |   * @throw invalid_argument if the args are improper.
   34|       |   */
   35|       |  void checkSafeEvaluateArgs(
   36|       |      const generic::MapSP<VariableName, double>& args) const;
   37|       |
   38|       | public:
   39|       |  /**
   40|       |   * @brief Construct an AnalyticFunction with a mapping of the function's
   41|       |   * arguments to their names.
   42|       |   * @param labels The label for each element of the vector

   44|       |   */

   46|       |                   const std::string&                   expression);
   47|       |  /**

   49|       |   * The equation is : x[0] where x[0] is some supplied quantity.
   50|       |   */
   51|       |  static std::shared_ptr<AnalyticFunction> Identity();
   52|       |  /**

   54|       |   * The equation is : const where const is supplied here on construction.
   55|       |   */
   56|       |  static std::shared_ptr<AnalyticFunction> Constant(const double& value);
   57|       |  /**

   13|       | *
   14|       | * - Default constructor: creates an empty Connections container.
   15|       | *   @code
   16|       | *   Connections o;
   17|       | *   @endcode
   18|       | *
   19|       | * - Sized constructor: creates an Connections container with a given
   20|       | * number of default-initialized elements.
   21|       | *   @param count Number of elements.
   22|       | *   @code
   23|       | *   Connections o(10);
   24|       | *   @endcode
   25|       | *
   26|       | * - Fill constructor: creates an Connections container with a given
   27|       | * number of copies of a specified value.
   28|       | *   @param count Number of elements.
   29|       | *   @param value Value to copy.
   30|       | *   @code
   31|       | *   Connections o(10, someConnectionsP);
   32|       | *   @endcode
   33|       | *
   34|       | * - Vector constructor: creates an Connections container from an existing
   35|       | * vector of ConnectionSP.
   36|       | *   @param vec Vector of ConnectionSP to copy.
   37|       | *   @code
   38|       | *   std::vector<ConnectionsP> v = ...;
   39|       | *   Connections o(v);
   40|       | *   @endcode
   41|       | * - Initializer list constructor: creates a Connections container
   42|       | *from an initializer list of shared pointers.
   43|       | *   @param init Initializer list of shared_ptr<T> to copy.
   44|       | *   @code
   45|       | *   Connections o{ptr1, ptr2, ptr3};
